answer.value: TV series dominate dataset with 952 entries and show strong performance in score (0.4611) and members (0.0893) dimensions. Movies (416 entries) perform well in score (0.4502) and popularity (0.2714). ONA series (256 entries) excel in popularity (0.4641) but have lower members (0.0084). OVA series (248 entries) show moderate scores (0.3466) but good popularity (0.3235). Special and TV Special types have smaller sample sizes and show varied performance across dimensions. The data suggests TV series have broadest reach while ONA series have high relative popularity despite fewer members

key_insights: TV series dominate dataset with highest count and strong score/members performance
ONA series excel in popularity but have lower member counts
Movies show balanced performance across score and popularity
OVA series have moderate scores but good popularity levels
Special and TV Special types have smaller sample sizes with varied performance
